about: Petawawa is a town in Renfrew County, Ontario, on the Ottawa River northwest of Pembroke beside CFB Petawawa. Military community life, river beaches, and Canadian Shield forest define a northeastern Ontario town closely tied to the base. Highway 17 is the main corridor. About 18,000 people live in Petawawa.
